title: Lawn Care Customer Completion Sign-Off Form
subtitle: Control mowing, cultivation, irrigation review, treatment, and property handoff through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete lawn care customer completion sign-off for turf zones, plantings, irrigation features, and service equipment. It connects service plan, product label, site map, and instructions to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a qualified lawn-care technician or applicator and property owner or authorized site contact must reconcile the promised lawn care scope, actual work, evidence, limitations, remaining actions, and custody transfer.

sections.guidance: Present the actual observations and limitations supporting the completion claim.

sections.title: Lawn Care limitations, unresolved concerns, and callback plan
sections.guidance: Acceptance must not conceal a defect, incomplete task, service restriction, or promised follow-up.

blocks.label: Unresolved condition or follow-up trigger
items: People, pets, traffic, or property remain in the discharge or work zone
Hidden utility, irrigation, wire, drain, or obstacle location uncertain
Slope, wet ground, drop-off, heat, storm, or lightning condition unsafe
Equipment guard, blade, tire, control, or emergency stop is defective
Product label, qualification, PPE, weather, or application boundary not met
Spray drift, runoff, overspread, spill, or non-target plant exposure
Tree, branch, retaining wall, sinkhole, or structural condition appears unstable
Property line, customer instruction, or protected zone is disputed
Plant damage, disease, or condition exceeds authorized lawn-care scope
Work would conflict with irrigation, construction, occupants, or another vendor

blocks.guidance: Use this lawn care customer completion sign-off with the applicable customer agreement, manufacturer information, product instructions, site policy, licensing, safety, privacy, and retention requirements. It records the stated decision but does not create authority, coverage, compliance, or release when identity, evidence, scope, condition, or acceptance remains unresolved.
